import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        TaskA solver = new TaskA();
        solver.solve(1, in, out);
        out.close();
    }

    static class TaskA {
        static final double EPS = 1e-9;

        public void solve(int testNumber, Scanner in, PrintWriter out) {
            for (int test = 1; ; test++) {
                int n = in.nextInt();
                int D = in.nextInt(); // D is not used for circles problem
                if (n == 0 && D == 0) {
                    break;
                }
                out.println("@" + test);
                Circle[] circles = new Circle[n];
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    double x = in.nextDouble();
                    double y = in.nextDouble();
                    double r = in.nextDouble();
                    circles[i] = new Circle(new Point(x, y), r);
                }

                // Count distinct intersection points
                List<Point> allIntersections = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
                        List<Point> pts = getIntersections(circles[i], circles[j]);
                        allIntersections.addAll(pts);
                    }
                }
                // Deduplicate points
                List<Point> uniquePoints = new ArrayList<>();
                for (Point p : allIntersections) {
                    boolean found = false;
                    for (Point q : uniquePoints) {
                        if (p.distanceTo(q) < EPS) {
                            found = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (!found) {
                        uniquePoints.add(p);
                    }
                }
                int I = uniquePoints.size();

                // Build graph of circles and find connected components
                DSU dsu = new DSU(n);
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
                        double d = circles[i].center.distanceTo(circles[j].center);
                        double r1 = circles[i].radius;
                        double r2 = circles[j].radius;
                        // Check if circles intersect (including tangency)
                        if (d < r1 + r2 + EPS && d > Math.abs(r1 - r2) - EPS) {
                            // Avoid identical circles (d=0 and r1=r2) which would cause infinite intersections
                            if (d > EPS || Math.abs(r1 - r2) > EPS) {
                                dsu.union(i, j);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                // Count number of components (including isolated circles)
                int C = 0;
                boolean[] visited = new boolean[n];
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (!visited[dsu.find(i)]) {
                        visited[dsu.find(i)] = true;
                        C++;
                    }
                }

                // Number of regions = I + 1 + C
                long regions = (long) I + 1 + C;
                out.println(regions);
            }
        }

        // Returns intersection points of two circles (0, 1, or 2 points)
        static List<Point> getIntersections(Circle c1, Circle c2) {
            List<Point> res = new ArrayList<>();
            double d = c1.center.distanceTo(c2.center);
            double r1 = c1.radius;
            double r2 = c2.radius;
            if (d > r1 + r2 + EPS || d < Math.abs(r1 - r2) - EPS) {
                return res; // no intersection
            }
            if (d < EPS) {
                // concentric circles: no intersection unless identical (r1 == r2)
                if (Math.abs(r1 - r2) < EPS) {
                    // identical circles: would give infinite intersections, treat as no intersection
                    return res;
                } else {
                    return res;
                }
            }
            // a = (r1^2 - r2^2 + d^2) / (2*d)
            double a = (r1 * r1 - r2 * r2 + d * d) / (2.0 * d);
            double h2 = r1 * r1 - a * a;
            if (h2 < -EPS) {
                return res; // no intersection (should not happen due to earlier check)
            }
            double h = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.0, h2));
            // midpoint of the chord
            Point mid = c1.center.add(c2.center.sub(c1.center).scale(a / d));
            if (h < EPS) {
                // tangent
                res.add(mid);
            } else {
                // perpendicular vector
                Point perp = c2.center.sub(c1.center).rotate(Math.PI / 2).norm().scale(h);
                res.add(mid.add(perp));
                res.add(mid.sub(perp));
            }
            return res;
        }

        static class Circle {
            Point center;
            double radius;

            Circle(Point center, double radius) {
                this.center = center;
                this.radius = radius;
            }
        }

        static class Point {
            double x;
            double y;

            Point(double x, double y) {
                this.x = x;
                this.y = y;
            }

            Point add(Point o) {
                return new Point(x + o.x, y + o.y);
            }

            Point sub(Point o) {
                return new Point(x - o.x, y - o.y);
            }

            Point rotate(double alpha) {
                double c = Math.cos(alpha);
                double s = Math.sin(alpha);
                double nx = x * c - y * s;
                double ny = x * s + y * c;
                return new Point(nx, ny);
            }

            Point norm() {
                double len = length();
                return scale(1.0 / len);
            }

            Point scale(double f) {
                return new Point(f * x, f * y);
            }

            double length() {
                return Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y);
            }

            double distanceTo(Point o) {
                return sub(o).length();
            }

            public String toString() {
                return String.format("%.2f %.2f", x, y);
            }
        }

        static class DSU {
            int[] parent;

            DSU(int n) {
                parent = new int[n];
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) parent[i] = i;
            }

            int find(int x) {
                if (parent[x] != x) parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
                return parent[x];
            }

            void union(int a, int b) {
                int ra = find(a);
                int rb = find(b);
                if (ra != rb) parent[ra] = rb;
            }
        }
    }
}
